english.meaning: to choose people, such as staff or partners, carefully
english.note: 揀人揀得犀利 means very good at choosing people.

exampleSentences.english: He’s pretty picky about who he chooses, huh? Really?
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉佢揀人都揀得幾犀利喎，會唔會啊？
